text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-05, Stainless Steel Contemporary Cartesius Knob

With its simple, elegant shape Acorn's Contemporary Cartesius Knob is a lovely finishing touch. Not just for kitchens, this knob is great for any light weight door like accordion closet doors, hutch drawers, and interior window shutters. It is made out of stainless steel and has a brushed stainless steel finish.

Also Available Matching Cartesius Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Contemporary Cartesius Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
